# Vishal Akshintala

> Technology lawyer specializing in AI governance, data privacy, cybersecurity law, and space law advisory, across India, the EU, UK, US, and APAC. NALSAR University of Law alumnus and ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, affiliated with Radhical Global Attorneys (Hyderabad, India).

Vishal Akshintala advises organizations on AI risk classification under the EU AI Act, data fiduciary obligations under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) 2023, cybersecurity incident-response obligations under CERT-In directions, and jurisdictional questions in space law including orbital data infrastructure and satellite AI systems under the 1967 Outer Space Treaty. He also delivers one-on-one and cohort AI governance training programs for legal and compliance teams.
